art_direction: RoomScale category: settlement_structure. Create a compact, visibly open Scavenger work bay within the existing 23 x 9 x 12 inch presentation envelope. At the 64-inch Room A camera, make the shared hand-work bench, one broad wall-mounted tool board, and the clear open work entrance read before small tools. Build the work area from repaired pallet timber, reused drawer boards, a faded blue or cream appliance panel, mismatched galvanized rain sheets and one restrained canvas patch. Give it a lean improvised silhouette distinct from a depot loading shed and paired housing. Show believable supports, a plain hand vise, a small parts crate and several clearly separated large tool shapes. Preserve the current landmark and all simulation-owned work-site behavior.
